info.name: Clinical Recommendations Service API
info.description: Postman collection for Clinical Recommendations Service REST API. Evidence-based recommendations from patient context, specialty consultation, and user-role perspective.

request.description: Check service health and OpenAI API status
Full recommendations from complete patient context. All recommendation types and focus areas.
Recommendations with minimal required patient data (default recommendation_types: general)
General specialty consultation – summary of standard protocols, tests, and procedures for the specialty (no patient context)
Specialty consultation with optional patient context and chief complaint
Recommendations from the perspective of the logged-in user's specialty (e.g. as a cardiologist would evaluate)
User-role recommendations with minimal required patient data
